rows.title: The Fog Of War | Reviews
rows.dek_lead: Errol Morris's latest documentary/essay, The Fog Of War, is a brilliant, nuanced examination of the career of Robert S McNamara, who served as secretary of defence in the US cabinet during the Vietnam War.
